demos.title: Weather Contradiction (Easy)
demos.description: One obvious contradiction, no red herrings. Good for a first sanity check.

demos.title: Maya's Locket (Medium)
demos.description: Multiple entities, a state violation, a timeline contradiction, and a legal flag.

demos.title: Chain of Custody (Hard)
demos.description: An object passes between three characters; the contradiction is buried in an otherwise plausible sequence.

demos.title: Explained Decoys (Very Hard)
demos.description: Several changes ARE explained in-story and should NOT be flagged — tests false-positive avoidance, not just detection.

demos.title: Legal Precision Test
demos.description: Mix of real-world references that should and should not be flagged — tests the Legal Clearance agent's judgment, not just keyword matching.
